import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Read the data
data = """brand,model_year,megapixels,max_iso,weight_grams,price_usd,sensor_type,has_video_4k,lens_mount,body_type
Leica,2005,13.5,25600,324,811.8,Micro 4/3,1,E,Compact
Fuji,2019,46.4,51200,1151,3596.41,APS-C,0,EF,Mirrorless
Pentax,2012,38.7,12800,598,3357.2,Full Frame,0,MFT,Mirrorless
Olympus,2015,22.5,6400,1095,1555.7,APS-C,0,Z,Mirrorless
Leica,2016,12.2,25600,290,3899.09,Medium Format,0,MFT,DSLR"""

from io import StringIO
df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Create a comprehensive visualization
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Price vs Megapixels colored by brand
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
for brand in df['brand'].unique():
    brand_data = df[df['brand'] == brand]
    ax1.scatter(brand_data['megapixels'], brand_data['price_usd'], 
                label=brand, s=100, alpha=0.7)
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Price vs Megapixels by Brand', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(fontsize=8)
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. Weight vs Price
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
colors = plt.cm.viridis(np.linspace(0, 1, len(df)))
ax2.scatter(df['weight_grams'], df['price_usd'], c=colors, s=100, alpha=0.7)
ax2.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Price vs Weight', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 3. Model Year distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
ax3.bar(df['brand'], df['model_year'], color=colors, alpha=0.7)
ax3.set_xlabel('Brand', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Model Year', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_title('Model Year by Brand', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax3.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 4. Sensor Type distribution
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
sensor_counts = df['sensor_type'].value_counts()
ax4.pie(sensor_counts.values, labels=sensor_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        startangle=90, textprops={'fontsize': 9})
ax4.set_title('Sensor Type Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 5. Body Type distribution
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
body_counts = df['body_type'].value_counts()
ax5.bar(body_counts.index, body_counts.values, color=sns.color_palette('Set2'), alpha=0.7)
ax5.set_xlabel('Body Type', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_title('Body Type Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 6. Max ISO comparison
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
ax6.barh(df['brand'], df['max_iso'], color=colors, alpha=0.7)
ax6.set_xlabel('Max ISO', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_ylabel('Brand', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_title('Max ISO by Brand', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='x')

# 7. 4K Video capability
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
video_counts = df['has_video_4k'].value_counts()
labels = ['No 4K', '4K']
ax7.bar(labels, [video_counts.get(0, 0), video_counts.get(1, 0)], 
        color=['coral', 'lightblue'], alpha=0.7)
ax7.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_title('4K Video Capability', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 8. Megapixels by Year
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
ax8.scatter(df['model_year'], df['megapixels'], c=colors, s=100, alpha=0.7)
ax8.set_xlabel('Model Year', fontsize=10)
ax8.set_ylabel('Megapixels', fontsize=10)
ax8.set_title('Megapixels vs Model Year', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax8.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 9. Summary statistics table
ax9 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
ax9.axis('off')
summary_stats = [
    ['Avg Price:', f'${df["price_usd"].mean():.2f}'],
    ['Avg Weight:', f'{df["weight_grams"].mean():.1f}g'],
    ['Avg MP:', f'{df["megapixels"].mean():.1f}'],
    ['Brands:', str(df["brand"].nunique())],
    ['Cameras:', str(len(df))]
]
table = ax9.table(cellText=summary_stats, cellLoc='left', loc='center',
                  colWidths=[0.5, 0.5], bbox=[0, 0.2, 1, 0.6])
table.auto_set_font_size(False)
table.set_fontsize(10)
table.scale(1, 2)
ax9.set_title('Summary Statistics', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=20)

plt.suptitle('Camera Dataset Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.98)
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
